parts.why: RelayHub.sol 1566-1599: relayCall calls canRelay (recover at 1520) and on failure emits CanRelayFailed and returns before nonce, call or charge; a relayed call checked in the same call is excluded from PQ-15 by patterns.md

penalizeRepeatedNonce/IllegalTransaction (1789-1829) recover relay-signed raw txs later; a zero recovery hits penalize's 'Unstaked relay' require. Caveat: the party who migrates is the offending relay itself, the stake belongs to its separate owner, who can already removeRelayByOwner+unstake after the delay; the loser is a would-be reporter's reward, so PQ-15 fit and severity remain a judgment for the registry
both relays the author named read all-zero at the pinned block and 0x7a6D... has no code; hub holds 10.169 ETH (recipient deposits and/or stakes, not separable without logs)

erc1271.note: recovery paths use ECDSA.recover/ecrecover only; no isValidSignature selector in code

unused-implementation.note: not a proxy target; holds 10.17 ETH itself

key-state.note: whether any relay is Staked/Registered/Removed now needs Staked/RelayAdded/Unstaked logs over the whole history; gateway refuses wide log scans

path-closed.note: stake/registerRelay have no admin gate (1376,1408), so the penalize path can reopen any time

rechecked-later.note: the later recheck is penalize*, as the author says; the relayCall recheck is same-call

taken-back.note: relay owner can removeRelayByOwner then unstake after the delay without migrating, limiting the window the reporter relies on; registry must weigh this

wrong-code.note: verified source at this address is the RelayHub read

value-whose.note: 10.169 ETH split between recipient deposits and relay stakes unknown without logs

gas.note: no fixed gas around the recovery; relayCall charges measured gas

breaks-by-itself.note: no fixed gas on recovery; failure needs a signer with code

objections: whether any relay is staked now (live slashing path) cannot be read without full-history logs
penalize path: the migrating party is the cheating relay and its owner can already exit after the unstake delay; PQ-15 fit is doubtful, more likely no rated finding
